name: AresAtlas Research Asymmetric Hazard Misclassification Cost Matrix
description: Quantifies the consequential asymmetry of terrain classification errors in simulated planetary navigation. Rows: Ground Truth Class (y), Columns: Predicted Class (y_hat).

rationale.Sand_as_Soil: Lethal slip hazard: Rover enters aeolian dune expecting firm traction, risking irreversible wheel sinkage (e.g., Opportunity Purgatory Dune / Curiosity Pahrump Hills).
rationale.BigRock_as_Soil: Catastrophic chassis collision: Rover plots path directly through a 20+ cm boulder, causing severe undercarriage impact or high-centering.
rationale.BigRock_as_Bedrock: Catastrophic strike: Rover mistakes elevated boulder for flat bedrock outcrop.
rationale.Soil_as_Sand: Suboptimal conservatism: Rover plans minor detour around harmless regolith.
rationale.Soil_as_BigRock: Suboptimal detour: Rover avoids safe terrain due to false obstacle detection.
